# Telegram Command Reference

<!-- Generated by `engram commands --format markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

These are the commands registered by Engram for its authorized Telegram chat. Reply controls and inline buttons are documented separately in [Session controls](session-controls.md).

## Service

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/help` | Show available commands |
| `/status` | Show service, state, and tmux status |
| `/mode [guide\|snapshot]` | Show or change the live anchor mode |
| `/logs` | Send service audit logs as an attachment |
| `/restart` | Restart Engram without closing tmux sessions |

## Saved Input

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/remember [<name> [text]]` | List, inspect, or save an input template |
| `/forget <name>` | Forget a saved input template |
| `/templates export` | Export all remembered input templates as JSON |

## Sessions

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/sessions` | List tracked terminal sessions with controls |
| `/recovery` | Show a deterministic plan for lost sessions |
| `/attach <tmux-target>` | Track an existing tmux window or pane |
| `/new <text>` | Create a tmux window and send text as a shell command |
| `/resume <id> [<codex\|claude> <session-uuid>]` | Restore a lost agent session into its existing watch |
| `/send <id> <text>` | Send text as a shell command to a session |
| `/text <id> <text>` | Send literal text without pressing Enter |
| `/key <id> <keys...>` | Send tmux key names to a session |
| `/rename <id> <name>` | Rename a tracked session |
| `/cwd <id>` | Show a session pane's working directory |
| `/cd <id> <path>` | Change a session pane's working directory |
| `/watch <id>` | Enable anchor updates for a session |
| `/unwatch <id>` | Disable anchor updates for a session |
| `/close <id>` | Close an Engram window or untrack an attached pane |

## Capture

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/dump <id>` | Send the full tmux scrollback as an attachment |
| `/raw <id>` | Send the visible tmux pane as an attachment |

## Files

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/attachments` | List files received from Telegram |
| `/download <absolute-path>` | Upload an absolute local path to Telegram |
| `/attachment_bypass sha256:<hash>` | Authorize one large attachment by SHA-256 |

## Reply Input

Reply with `//text` to send `/text` to that session. For example, `//clear` sends the literal text `/clear` without pressing Enter.
